mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing codeine metabolism to its active metabolite morphine, potentially decreasing analgesic efficacy while increasing codeine toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for reduced codeine efficacy and signs of codeine accumulation; consider alternative analgesic or increased codeine dosing under clinical supervision; separate administration timing may provide modest benefit.
